meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 当用户对 senpi 的任何 Tip 提示提问时,Claude 会先查询实时提示列表,核对当前用户实际可见的提示,再阅读相关源码验证功能,最后用用户所用的语言深入解释该提示背后的真实机制和代码路径。
howto.when: 当用户说“give-me-tips”、问某条 Tip: 行是什么意思,或询问提示功能如何工作时等场景触发。

say.text: 解释一下刚才那条 Tip: 到底在说什么
say.note: 会先查实时列表再验证代码后解释

say.text: 运行 give-me-tips,讲讲启动时的提示
say.note: 会给出当前用户可见提示的深度解释

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后的提示,它的机制是什么?
say.note: 会讲解回退架构的完整流程

howto.what_en: When the user asks about any senpi tip, Claude first queries the live tip list, checks which tips this user can actually see, then reads the relevant source code to verify the feature, and finally explains the real mechanism and code paths in depth, in the user's language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "give-me-tips", asks what a Tip: line means, or asks how a tipped feature works, etc.

say_en.text: Explain what that Tip: line just said
say_en.note: Queries the live list and verifies code first

say_en.text: Run give-me-tips and walk me through the startup tip
say_en.note: Gives a deep explanation of tips visible to you

say_en.text: What is the mechanism behind the Fable-5-refusal tip?
